description: This Java source file defines the ModifyFeature class, which represents a command to modify an existing Feature in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creation from parameters or JSON, and handles serialization and validation for modifying features associated with a Thing.

classes.name: ModifyFeature
classes.description: A command class for modifying an existing Feature within a Thing, including serialization, deserialization, and validation logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyFeature with a string or ThingId, feature, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a ModifyFeature command from JSON string or object.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the Feature to be modified.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this command.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature being modified.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the feature entity.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the feature resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload with thing ID, feature ID, and feature data.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the command.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the command instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another ModifyFeature object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the command.
